subject: Dedicated capacity hardware mix & temporary rate smoothing request
messages:
From: Daniel Park <dpark@edgehealth.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeHealth Procurement <procurement@edgehealth.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity request — hardware mix + billing smoothing

Hi Olga,

We are preparing to ramp a new model evaluation and would like to request a temporary switch of our dedicated GPU pool from A100 to H100 for performance parity. Primary asks:
- Swap pool hardware to H100 for a 45-day evaluation
- A reservation hold / pause on contract start for 45 days while we complete procurement
- Temporary smoothing of overage rates (reduce incremental overage for first billing period)

Timeline: need the pool change by Dec 6 to hit our test window. Procurement will likely sign 4-6 weeks after evaluation.

Attaching our most recent usage snapshot.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of ML Engineering
EdgeHealth
Attachment: EdgeHealth_Q4_usage_snapshot.csv (csv)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@edgehealth.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request — hardware mix + billing smoothing

Hi Daniel,

Thanks for the clear summary — we can support a temporary hardware mix change but this is a non-standard operations and billing request so I need to escalate to Deal Desk and Execs for sign-off. A few quick clarifying questions so I can bundle everything in one request: 
1) Can you confirm target pool size (number of GPUs / vCPU equivalent)?
2) Are you requesting full H100 SKUs or a mixed H100/H100s (smaller variant) pool?
3) Does Procurement want an amendment or a post-signing credit schedule?

Ballpark on cost delta: H100 will run materially higher per-hour than your current A100 band — rough estimate ~18-25% higher unit cost depending on exact SKU and quantization profile. If you want, Aditya can run a quick perf/cost sim with your usage snapshot and recommended batching/cache knobs.

I will open a Deal Desk escalation and copy LAUREN/Vivek for the temporary rate smoothing + reservation hold. Will follow up within 24 hours with proposed guardrails.

Best,
Olga
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request — technical feasibility and cost sketch

Olga,

Quick technical notes after running their snapshot through our perf model:
- H100 provides an estimated 20% median throughput improvement for their model family at 2048 context. Peak token/sec improvement could be up to 30% on fp16 paths.
- Compatibility: their current model uses kernels that are supported on H100 with no code changes. Multi-GPU scaling will require slight kv-cache tuning.
- Cost delta estimate: if current A100 band is $X/hr, full H100 replacement is +18-22% on unit compute. After applying batching and prefix caching we can often recover 6-9% of that increase.

Operational items I recommend including in any temporary approval:
- Limit the hardware swap to a named pool (EdgeHealth-Q4-eval) and isolate traffic.
- 72-hour burst grace pool (small buffer for initial ramp) capped at 5x baseline for three days.
- Require that any long-running reservation starts after the evaluation or procurement signature (i.e., allow a reservation hold).

Attaching a short compatibility matrix and perf sketch.

-- Aditya
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: hw_compatibility_matrix.pdf (pdf)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:07:00-08:00
Subject: Deal Desk: EdgeHealth EH-2026-1223 — request for non-standard hardware & rate smoothing

Hi Lauren / Vivek,

Summarizing request from EdgeHealth (deal EH-2026-1223):
- Temporary pool hardware swap from A100 -> H100 for a named dedicated pool (45-day evaluation)
- Reservation hold / pause on contract start for 45 days to let them complete procurement
- Temporary overage smoothing: reduce incremental overage by 20% for first billing period after swap (they are asking for the first 30-45 days)

Customer asks are time-sensitive: they need the pool changed by Dec 6 to meet an internal eval window. Aditya has provided perf/cost delta and recommended burst guardrails.

Proposed Deal Desk recommendation for Exec approval:
- Approve H100 swap for the named pool, operationalized as an isolated pool (EdgeHealth-Q4-eval)
- Approve a reservation hold of up to 45 days but prefer 30 days as a conservative limit
- Approve temporary overage smoothing: 20% credit applied to overage for the first 30 days only (finance impact estimated at ~$12k for worst-case)

Attachments: usage snapshot, Aditya's compatibility matrix.
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/eh-2026-1223

Asks: Vivek — need final executive approval on non-standard billing and hardware. Lauren — will you please confirm Deal Desk constraints (shorter hold vs. longer discount window)?

Thanks,
Olga
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Deal Desk: EdgeHealth EH-2026-1223 — request for non-standard hardware & rate smoothing

Olga, Vivek,

My thoughts: we can be flexible but need tighter guardrails to limit revenue exposure. Suggested adjustments to Olga's proposal:
- Reservation hold: approve up to 30 days only (not 45).
- Overage smoothing: approve a 15% credit for the first 30 days (not 20% for 45 days).
- Require CISO sign-off on H100 placement and a written commitment from customer to convert to a 6-month reserved volume within 45 days of evaluation end if production performance matches expectations.
- Finance should sign-off on the estimated impact before sending to customer.

If those are acceptable, I support moving to Vivek for final sign-off.

Thanks,
Lauren
VP, Deal Desk
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Deal Desk: EdgeHealth EH-2026-1223 — executive approval

Folks,

I reviewed the summary and Finance's rough impact. I approve the following, with conditions:
- Approve H100 hardware swap for the named evaluation pool (EdgeHealth-Q4-eval).
- Approve reservation hold for up to 30 days only.
- Approve temporary overage credit of 15% for the first 30 days post-swap.
Conditions:
1) Customer must sign an amendment (DocuSign) that includes the temporary credits and the conversion commitment to a minimum 6-month reserved volume within 45 days of evaluation finish.
2) CISO sign-off must be completed prior to any H100 placement into their VPC or private deployment.
3) Finance must review the final amendment for accounting treatment; do not apply credits until Finance confirms.

Olga — please notify the customer with these terms and attach the amendment link. If they accept, route to Legal/Finance for finalization.

— Vivek
